name: EPIC 201126598
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 11.7 solar radii and 1.53 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201126598 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.66435 (16th-84th percentiles 11.173569-12.186205), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201126598: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4743.9854 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201126598 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1214.072266 (16th-84th percentiles 1177.519531-1265.322266), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = -0.04 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,214 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.53 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,744 K at its surface.
